document: Targeted original-source conflict and qualification register — bounded trial v0.2.0
status: Original sources read-only; no silent key/source revision. Both current02/05 inputs fully covered by initial reads plus bounded deltas. Closed wording repairs are distinct from unresolved assessment/source-method decisions.

items.observation: The original uses test-cross wording broadly for parental/F1 work.
items.disposition: Technical testcross means crossing to a recessive tester; current02 uses controlled cross/self-pollination and retains the intended Mendel sequence.

items.observation: Slide15 presents schematic3:1 fractions. Actual source count5474:1850 is approximately2.96:1.
items.disposition: Current02 distinguishes prediction from compulsory finite outcomes and cites real counts from Figure17.5, not slide15.

items.locator: PPT actual22–23; textbook printed589/PDF6 and597/PDF14 Figure17.14
items.observation: Contribution separation and random union have distinct mechanisms; blanket two-copy wording needs an ordinary diploid-locus scope.
items.disposition: Current02 separates segregation from fertilisation and explicitly bounds diploid/haploid, seed genotype and ordinary autosomal assumptions.

items.locator: Textbook printed593/PDF10 Figure17.10 and adjacent dihybrid prose
items.observation: One figure parent label reads TgGg where surrounding cross/grid implies TtGg; a9:3:3:1 phenotype ratio is not true of every two-trait cross.
items.disposition: Original figure remains unchanged. Current05 derives9:3:3:1 only for TtGg×TtGg under independence, complete dominance, complete penetrance and equal scoring. Protected structural answer overlap is separately recorded asSRC-BOUND-02.

items.classification: Context ambiguity, not a proven diagram-stage error
items.observation: Text mentions metaphaseI while referring to prior meiosisII notes; image includes more than one meiotic stage.
items.disposition: Teach independent homolog orientation at meiosisI. Do not declare the full source image places the event in meiosisII solely from its context label.

items.classification: Certain terminology error and overbroad scope
items.observation: Synapsis is homolog pairing, not separation. Statements making all genes independently assort need linkage qualification.
items.disposition: New source-derived account must distinguish pairing/separation and state the different/unlinked-locus model. Original text remains read-only.

items.observation: Squash task shifts fruit to flower terminology and calls the count actual. Its80-seed denominator does not itself establish80 plants successfully grown/scored.
items.disposition: Current05 retains inverse genotype reasoning before resolved parents, W/D andN80. It explicitly counts80 plants grown/scored and expected40/20, corrects fruit/flower terminology, and does not claim this cross proves independent assortment.

items.locator: Native05 optional textbook tasks: printed595/PDF12 questions13,15,16
items.observation: These preserved questions require incomplete-dominance/codominance ideas beyond the simple complete-dominance05 model.
items.disposition: Current05 includes the explicit return-after06 cue. Original tasks and reader bindings remain unchanged; this is a supported sequencing accommodation, not missing source availability.

items.locator: Original quiz_d2l_59230.xml itemsOBJ_2131227,OBJ_2131236,OBJ_2131237,OBJ_2131242; current native05 corresponding source-derived items
items.observation: Original question assumptions and simplistic human-trait context are not reliable universal facts; current native versions use explicit simple/abstract models.
items.disposition: Protected native prompt/options/keys/feedback remain authoritative and unchanged. Do not introduce original simplistic human traits as established Mendelian facts.

items.classification: Protected assessment / source-method conflict remains unresolved
items.locator: PPT actual43–45; native ch17-l05-check-writing-1 and ch17-l05-check-writing-2
items.observation: Original RrTt×rrTt fully solves the protected gamete-list task and is isomorphic to the protected1/8 phenotype target. Letter changes do not solve that problem.
items.disposition: Completed candidate RrTt×RRTt changes the phenotype answer but keeps strong4×2 template overlap and loses two nonzero phenotype groups. This remains unresolved for Dean. Correct calculations and completed source review do not clear source-demand/assessment readiness.

items.disposition: These original tasks are unchanged and are not imported as solved trial tasks. Relevant-task search is not a full reread of every chapter problem.

items.classification: Source-core/protected assessment overlap, unresolved acceptance boundary
items.locator: PPT actual35–40; printed593/PDF10 Figure17.10; native ch17-l05-check-mc-2 and ch17-source-OBJ_2131237
items.observation: The full source pea derivation explicitly includes ttG_3/16 and T_gg3/16, structurally equivalent to the protected aaB_ and A_bb targets under dominance-preserving relabelling.

items.locator: New05 ch17-l05-teaching-01-p2; original first-read6007eedc versus finaleac351c0
items.observation: Initial new sentence said sister separation completes the reduction, which could put chromosome-set reduction in meiosisII.
items.disposition: Root changed it to completes meiosis. Exact bounded delta read; homolog separation in meiosisI remains the reduction mechanism. No source edit.

items.observation: A→b branch reaches location markerB, while the footer key decodes B·Ab. Location markers and allele letters must be distinguished.
items.disposition: Current paragraph explicitly identifies the bottom marker and key. Native SVG source geometry/text read directly; no asset change or browser-render claim.

items.classification: Adjacent original-source reservation, not imported into current05 mechanism
items.observation: Printed599 specifies exchange between nonsister chromatids; adjacent600 says sister chromatids and overgeneralizes uniform crossover likelihood. Those source phrasings need qualification for later detailed linkage teaching.
items.disposition: The current05 boundary only states close linked loci can have unequal gamete frequencies. It does not import crossover geometry, fixed physical map distances or the original broad crossover-distribution claim. These two pages were targeted-text read for that boundary only.

limits: Concerns labelled ambiguity or qualification are not converted into certain source errors. No original missing-parent/daily-plan/mixed-test reading or current authority certification claimed.
